text:
maya: quick sync on benchmark launch artifacts — need a short launch post, webinar hook, two simple charts (latency vs $) and a gated calculator. primary audience: devs (trial) + platform buyers (demo). thoughts?
sam: propose two panels: left = per-1k-token cost across models/configs, right = p95 latency vs cost per 1k reqs. keep labels human-friendly ("$ / 1k tokens").
toni: visual notes: highlight batching/kvcache knee, use dashed fallback-model line, small inset for streaming latency for tiny prompts. use brand blues, single accent for callouts.
lee: inbound routing: signup form asks "typical monthly tokens" -> buckets: <50k (self-serve), 50k-500k (nurture), >500k (SDR). tag leads "bench_interest". sales outreach rule: >200k tokens or demo request.
maya: copy hooks: headline "From latency to dollars: benchmark what matters." social: "See how batching, caching & quantization change your token bill." short.
sam: I'll prepare the numbers. Caption ideas under each chart: left: "Unit costs fall as throughput increases; quantization shifts the curve down." right: "Tradeoff: lower p95 often means higher cost per token — pick the SLO"
benchbot: bench export ready: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/175501 — file: benchmark-econ-v3.csv (includes simulated traffic shapes + batching on/off).
toni: will mock two 1200x630 PNGs and a slide deck thumbnail. PNG ask: panel text legible at thumbnail size.
lee: webinar plan (10-15m): 1) problem + why cost surprises happen, 2) live demo of dashboard & calculator, 3) playbook: routing + rollout checklist. CTA: "Calculate your token economics" -> gated sheet + optional API sample.
maya: gated sheet = quick spreadsheet + prefilled formulas + sample CSV import. also provide a one-click curl example to compute estimate with free credits.
sam: sample curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/calc -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4","tokens":1000,"batch":8,"quant":"q4_0"}'```
toni: tiny UX ask: add microcopy on calculator about variance ("estimates assume steady-state throughput; spikes change p95").
lee: routing implementation: marketing adds hidden field "tokens_estimate" and sets lead owner via zap->crm mapping. ops to confirm tag names.
maya: timeline suggestion: draft visuals + numbers by Tue, copy Wed, page + gated sheet Fri, webinar the following Wed. owners: sam numbers, toni visuals, lee routing, maya copy + launch.
sam: I'll drop the kneepoint and raw CSV by Tue AM.
toni: I'll post figma links when mocks are ready.
lee: I'll test the form + routing on staging by Thu.
maya: ok thanks — small checklist: sam include batch sizes and cache enabled/disabled, toni export social PNG and slide-safe PNG, lee confirm crm tags. will run final review Tue afternoon. :tada:
